summary.short: Colombian statute on habeas data governing personal data in databases, especially financial, credit, commercial and service data. It sets data subjects' rights, duties of data sources, operators and users, retention limits for negative credit records, and supervisory sanctions. Applies from publication in December 2008.
summary.long: Colombian statute on habeas data regulating personal data in databases, particularly financial, credit, commercial, service and third-country information. It covers public and private database administrators, excluding certain intelligence databases, purely personal data and internal flows (Art. 2). Art. 4 sets principles of accuracy, purpose, restricted circulation, temporality, security and confidentiality. Art. 6 gives data subjects rights to consult, seek correction and request proof of authorization. Arts. 7 to 9 impose duties on operators, sources and users, including prior notice before reporting negative data (Art. 12). Art. 13 limits retention of negative data to double the delinquency period, up to four years after payment. Art. 15 restricts user access to listed purposes. Art. 16 sets procedures and deadlines for consultations and claims. Art. 17 empowers the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio and the Superintendencia Financiera to supervise, order audits and correct data. Art. 18 provides fines up to 2,000 monthly minimum wages, suspension up to six months and closure. Amended by Ley 2157 de 2021 and Ley 2573 de 2026 as compiled. It contains no provisions specific to AI systems.

notes: Consolidated text compiled by Avance Jurídico as of 30 Sep 2026; amendments by Ley 2157 de 2021 and Ley 2573 de 2026 appear as inserted new text, and the compilation's editor notes, jurisprudence markers and prior-text markers are not part of the law. Art. 13 sets two retention rules for negative data that the annotator should read together: a maximum of double the arrears period, up to four years from payment (main text), and an eight-year limit from default (paragraph 1). Several provisions are marked conditionally exequible (arts. 3 c, 3 d? not marked; see arts. 3 c, 5 d, 6 numerals 2.1 and 14 a-b, 17); Sentencia C-1011 of 16 Oct 2008 is recorded as the prior constitutional review. Art. 9 numeral 1 has a missing word in the source ('Guardar [gap] sobre la información'). Art. 20 names the supervisory body 'Superintendencia de Industria, Comercio y Financiera', which differs from the name used in art. 17.

evidence.quote: deben ser capaces de demostrar que han implementado medidas apropiadas, efectivas y verificables

obligations.summary: The effective measures must ensure an administrative organization proportional to the firm, policies consistent with the law, internal mechanisms for implementation and training, and processes for responding to holder consultations, petitions and claims, with special emphasis on data quality, prior notice, confidentiality and security.

evidence.quote: las medidas efectivas y apropiadas implementadas por los operadores, fuentes y usuarios de información deberán garantizar

obligations.summary: The Superintendence of Industry and Commerce and the Superintendence Financiera must assume the supervisory functions, and the National Government must take the necessary measures to adapt the structure of the Superintendence with budget and technical capacity.
obligations.applies_from: Six months after entry into force of the law

evidence.quote: adoptará las medidas necesarias para adecuar la estructura de la Superintendencia

obligations.summary: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force have up to six months to adapt their operations to the law. Transitional rules on retention of negative data apply (Art. 21, paragraphs 2-4).
obligations.applies_from: Six months after entry into force of the law
obligations.conditional_on: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force

evidence.quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuar su funcionamiento a las disposiciones de la presente ley

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio y Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
enforcement.triggered_by: Violación a la presente ley, normas que la reglamenten, así como por la inobservancia de las órdenes e instrucciones impartidas por dicha Superintendencia
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Multas de carácter personal e institucional hasta por el equivalente a dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes al momento de la imposición de la sanción
enforcement.currency: SMMLV (salario mínimo mensual legal vigente, unit of account)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Up to 2,000 monthly legal minimum wages (SMMLV) at the time of imposition; fines may be successive while the non-compliance that gave rise to them continues. Graduation criteria are set in Art. 19 (a) to (f).
enforcement.penalty_reference: Art. 18 (inciso modificado por el artículo 14 de la Ley 2157 de 2021)

evidence.quote: Multas de carácter personal e institucional hasta por el equivalente a dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio y Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
enforcement.triggered_by: Administración de la información en violación grave de las condiciones y requisitos previstos en la presente ley, así como por la inobservancia de las órdenes e instrucciones impartidas por las Superintendencias para corregir tales violaciones
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspensión de las actividades del banco de datos, hasta por un término de seis (6) meses
enforcement.currency: not applicable (duration, not a monetary amount)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Suspension lasts up to six months; no monetary amount applies.

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio y Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
enforcement.triggered_by: Failure to adjust the database's technical, logistical, norms and procedures to legal requirements after the suspension term, as ordered in the suspension resolution; and immediate closure for databases that process prohibited data
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cierre o clausura de operaciones del banco de datos cuando, una vez transcurrido el término de suspensión, no hubiere adecuado su operación técnica y logística; cierre inmediato y definitivo para bancos de datos que administren datos prohibidos
enforcement.currency: not applicable (closure of operations, not a monetary amount)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Closure of database operations; no monetary amount applies.
enforcement.cure_period: Closure applies only after the suspension term has elapsed without adjustment, except for databases processing prohibited data, where closure is immediate and definitive

enforcement.triggered_by: Correction, update or removal of personal data ordered ex officio or at the request of a party, when procedent under the law; a request requires proof that a complaint on the same facts was filed with the operator or source and not answered or answered unfavourably
